details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: Remote denial of service via TLS retransmit timeout
     integer overflow
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-84732.patch: cap the exponential backoff of
       the reliable layer retransmit timeout, limit --tls-timeout and ignore
       ACKs for packet IDs outside the send window in src/openvpn/options.c,
       src/openvpn/reliable.c, src/openvpn/reliable.h
     - CVE-2026-84732
